title: Grounding Multilingual Multimodal LLMs With Cultural Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating visual question answering and entity recognition performance on culture-specific multimodal benchmarks (e.g., CVQA, ALMBench, MaRVL) to assess how well models understand diverse, non-Western, and long-tail cultural entities across different regions.

Measuring and comparing accuracy on multilingual vision-language benchmarks across 39 diverse languages to evaluate performance disparities between high-resource (e.g., English) and low-resource or underrepresented languages.
